name: Seth
bio: Seth is the son born to Adam and Eve after Abel's death; Eve said, "God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew" (Genesis 4:25). Seth's line carried forward the godly lineage — Scripture records that it was in the days of his son Enos that "men began to call upon the name of the LORD" (Genesis 4:26). Seth is also placed at the head of the genealogy running through Noah to Abraham, making him a key figure in the continuation of humanity's blessed line.
